PRIMARY_NODE_DUPLEX_2_DESCRIPTION: Full duplex with telemetry tones and hang time. Preferred when interfacing with a repeater.

ALLMON_CONFIG_NOT_WRITABLE: The service does not have permission to write to this file; changes cannot be saved.
ALLSTAR_ADMIN_WARNING: These operations send real commands to Asterisk and may change links or system state. Use them only if you understand their effect.
ALLSTAR_LSNODES_PRIMARY_NODE: LsNodes status for the primary node
NET_CALC_EMPTY: Enter an IP address and select Calculate.
NET_CALC_INVALID_CIDR: The CIDR prefix must be between 0 and 32.
NET_CALC_ERROR: The subnet could not be calculated.
SHARED_COPY_FAILURE: Could not copy. Select the value and copy it manually.
WEATHER_CONFIGURED_LOCATION_MISSING: No location is configured by the administrator.
WEATHER_GEOLOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: This browser does not support geolocation. Use HTTPS or enter a location.
WEATHER_GEOLOCATION_PERMISSION_DENIED: Location permission denied. Enable it in your browser or enter a location.
WEATHER_GEOLOCATION_FAILED: Could not get your location. Try again or enter a location.
WEATHER_API_ERROR: Error while querying the Go API.
AST_LOG_LOAD_ERROR: Could not retrieve the operations log.
AST_LOG_NO_OPERATIONS: No operations have been recorded yet.
AUDIO_OPEN_AUDIO_WINDOW: Open Audio management in another window
AUDIO_OPEN_MONITOR_WINDOW: Open AllStarLink table in another window
AUDIO_WINDOW_BLOCKED: Could not open the window. Allow pop-up windows for this site.
AUDIO_FRAGMENT_HELP: Saving or broadcasting remembers the start and end for this audio, including scheduled intervals. The original file, local preview and download remain complete. Reset and save to return to the complete audio.
ECHOLINK_LOCATION_HELP: Requests permission to use this device's location, not the server's. Requires HTTPS or localhost. Check that it matches the station's location; you can edit the coordinates before saving.
ECHOLINK_LOCATION_READY: Coordinates filled in. Review them and press Save to keep them.
ECHOLINK_LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE: Geolocation is unavailable. Use HTTPS or localhost, or enter coordinates manually.
ECHOLINK_LOCATION_DENIED: Location permission denied. Enable it in your browser or enter coordinates manually.
ECHOLINK_LOCATION_TIMEOUT: Location request timed out. Try again or enter coordinates manually.
ECHOLINK_LOCATION_FAILED: Could not obtain a valid location. Try again or enter coordinates manually.
ECHOLINK_HELP: Edit an existing echolink.conf section. Saving does not activate or reload the module; apply the appropriate action afterwards. astnode is always saved as the current primary node number.
ECHOLINK_PASSWORD_HELP: Press the eye to retrieve the saved password or show the new one you type. Leave blank to keep the existing password; if none is configured, enter one. Use HTTPS to protect retrieval.
ECHOLINK_PASSWORD_ERROR: Could not retrieve the saved password.
ECHOLINK_RADIO_HELP: Power: code 0–9 (watts = code squared). Height: code 0–9 (10 × 2^code feet). Gain: 0–9 dB. Direction: 0 omnidirectional; 1–8 = 45°–360°. Messages support \n for line breaks.
ECHOLINK_CONFIRM_HELP: Disabling forces EchoLink to unload even when in use: it disconnects its links and may affect Asterisk stability. Asterisk is not restarted. Save form changes first.
ECHOLINK_ACTION_disable: Force unloading with module unload -f chan_echolink.so if active.
ECHOLINK_ACTION_reload: Reload chan_echolink.so to apply the saved file.
ECHOLINK_PERMANENT: Update load/noload in modules.conf and apply the change now. If the module operation fails, the file change remains.
ECHOLINK_TEMPORARY: Temporary operation: does not modify modules.conf.
ECHOLINK_PORTS_HELP: TCP 5200: tests outbound connections to configured servers. UDP 5198/5199: checks local sockets, not Internet access or socket ownership. Router, NAT, firewall and provider configuration are the administrator's responsibility; Amerimon does not open ports or certify public reachability.
ECHOLINK_SAVED: File saved with backup. Activate or reload the module to apply.
ECHOLINK_READ_ERROR: Cannot read echolink.conf. Check its existence and permissions.
ECHOLINK_STRUCTURE_ERROR: Unique elN sections without templates are required. Existing or unverifiable includes require manual editing; #tryinclude of missing files without wildcards is supported.
ECHOLINK_STATUS_ERROR: Cannot query module status through the local CLI. Check the asterisk executable and access to its control socket.
ECHOLINK_VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid configuration: check identity, servers and numeric bounds; do not use newlines, ; or #.
ECHOLINK_BUSY: Another configuration operation is in progress.
ECHOLINK_STALE: The file or primary node changed. Reload before saving.
ECHOLINK_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Enter an EchoLink password for this section.
ECHOLINK_BACKUP_ERROR: Cannot create backup. The file was not saved.
ECHOLINK_SAVE_ERROR: Cannot save the file. Check permissions.
ECHOLINK_MODULES_ERROR: Cannot update modules.conf; a unique modules section without includes is required. Check the file: a change may already have been saved.
ECHOLINK_NOT_LOADED: The module is not loaded. Enable it before reloading.
ECHOLINK_ACTIVATE_ERROR: Asterisk did not confirm the operation or expected module state. Saved files remain; check the local CLI, permissions and logs before retrying.
AUDIO_LISTEN_SELECTION_HELP: Local preview inside this dialog, without saving or broadcasting to Asterisk. Press play in the player. If you change the bounds, load the selection again.
AUDIO_FRAGMENT_DRAG_HELP: Drag the left handle for the start and the right handle for the end, or enter seconds below. The highlighted bar shows the segment.
AUDIO_ERROR_SEGMENT: Could not prepare the segment. Start must be before end and both must be within the audio.
AUDIO_PREVIEW_ERROR: Could not load the audio for local playback.
AUDIO_LEVEL_ERROR: Could not start the browser audio meter.
AUDIO_RECORD_HELP: Record the primary node listening feed and its connected stations. Capture is saved on the server even if you close this page. Listen plays only in your browser; Add to library creates a copy for broadcast or scheduling without playing it automatically.
AUDIO_RECORD_SILENCE_HELP: Silence is omitted automatically: capture resumes when audio is detected, retaining 200 ms before detection and 500 ms after. A manual pause requires Continue. One active recording; maximum 25 MiB WAV per recording (approximately 27 minutes of retained audio). Requires the EAGI listening setup.
AUDIO_RECORD_STARTED: Node capture started; silence is omitted automatically.
AUDIO_RECORD_ADDED: Copy added to the library. You can broadcast or schedule it from its card.
AUDIO_RECORD_DELETE_HELP: The recorded file will be deleted. If you added it to the library, that copy will be kept.
AUDIO_RECORD_LOAD_ERROR: Could not load recordings. Click Refresh to retry.
AUDIO_RECORD_START_ERROR: Could not start or confirm capture. Check AMI, the listening dialplan, and the EAGI connection to the server.
AUDIO_RECORD_WRITE_ERROR: Could not save the recording. Check server disk space and permissions.
AUDIO_RECORD_BUSY: A recording is already active. Stop it before starting another.
AUDIO_RECORD_NOT_ACTIVE: This recording is no longer active. Refresh the list.
AUDIO_RECORD_CONTROL_ERROR: Could not confirm the entire operation. Refresh the list and check the logs before retrying.
AUDIO_RECORD_FILE_ERROR: Could not open the recording file.
AUDIO_RECORD_DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the recording. Active captures cannot be deleted.
AUDIO_RECORD_LIBRARY_ERROR: Could not copy the recording to the library. Stop capture before copying it.
AUDIO_RECORD_ALREADY_ADDED: This recording has already been added to the library.
AUDIO_RECORD_EMPTY: The recording contains no valid audio to add to the library.
AUDIO_RECORD_INTERRUPTED: Capture was interrupted. Received audio is kept; capture does not resume automatically after a service restart.
AUDIO_RECORD_LIMIT: The 25 MiB limit was reached and the recording was saved automatically.
AUDIO_MANAGEMENT_DESCRIPTION: Manage WAV announcements for AllStarLink nodes over IAX/IAXRPT.
AUDIO_MODE_SILENCE: Broadcast to all stations during total silence
AUDIO_WAV_REQUIREMENTS: Accepts WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG/Opus, M4A/MP4, AAC, WMA, AIFF, WebM, MKA, AMR and APE. The server converts audio to 16-bit, 8000 Hz mono PCM WAV for Asterisk. Maximum: 25 MiB for both input and converted audio.
AUDIO_ERROR_INPUT_FORMAT: Unsupported format. Select WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG/Opus, M4A/MP4, AAC, WMA, AIFF, WebM, MKA, AMR or APE.
AUDIO_ERROR_CONVERTER_MISSING: The server needs FFmpeg to convert this audio. Install the ffmpeg package.
AUDIO_ERROR_CONVERSION_BUSY: The server is converting another audio file. Try again when it finishes.
AUDIO_ERROR_CONVERSION: Could not convert the file. Check that it contains valid audio and a codec supported by FFmpeg.
AUDIO_ERROR_CONVERSION_TIMEOUT: Conversion exceeded the time limit or was cancelled.
AUDIO_ERROR_CONVERTED_SIZE: Converted audio reaches the 25 MiB limit. Shorten it before uploading.
AUDIO_EMPTY: There are no audio tracks yet.
AUDIO_LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the audio library.
AUDIO_ERROR_DUPLEX: The primary node requires a duplex value from 1 to 4 in rpt.conf to broadcast audio to linked nodes. Update the node section and reload app_rpt.
AUDIO_DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this audio from the library?
AUDIO_ERROR_LIST: Could not retrieve the audio library.
AUDIO_ERROR_LIBRARY_READ: Could not read the audio library.
AUDIO_ERROR_UPLOAD_FIELDS: Enter a valid name and playback mode.
AUDIO_ERROR_INTERVAL: The interval must be between 1 and 10080 minutes.
AUDIO_ERROR_FILE_EXTENSION: The file must have a .wav extension.
AUDIO_ERROR_FILE_READ: Could not read the audio file.
AUDIO_ERROR_FILE_SIZE: The file is empty or exceeds 25 MiB.
AUDIO_ERROR_WAV_INVALID: The file is not a valid WAV.
AUDIO_ERROR_WAV_CHUNK: The WAV file contains an invalid chunk.
AUDIO_ERROR_WAV_HEADER: The WAV format chunk is invalid.
AUDIO_ERROR_WAV_FORMAT: Audio must be 8-bit or 16-bit, 8000 Hz mono PCM WAV.
AUDIO_ERROR_WAV_DURATION: The WAV duration exceeds the supported limit.
AUDIO_ERROR_STORAGE: Could not prepare the audio directory.
AUDIO_ERROR_SAVE_RECORD: Could not save the audio record.
AUDIO_ERROR_TRACK_READ: Could not read the audio track.
AUDIO_ERROR_DELETE_FILE: The record was deleted, but the audio file could not be removed.
AUDIO_ERROR_MANUAL_MODE: Manual playback is only available for one-time broadcasts.
AUDIO_ERROR_PLAYBACK_BUSY: Another audio is playing. Try again when it finishes.
AUDIO_ERROR_UNKNOWN: The audio operation could not be completed.
